model: Laya, continuation of the joint head training
training: shared decision head, encoder frozen; two extra epochs on the three questions
lr_note: reduced from 1e-3 because the Adam optimiser state is not stored in the checkpoint, so the run restarts with a fresh optimiser
split: identical to the 20-epoch run: by problem statement, 497 train / 503 held out, seed 0

generalisation_gap.note: train accuracy gained 2.4 points while held-out accuracy gained 0.4; the gap widening is the first measurable sign of overfitting

conclusion: Two extra epochs gain 0.4 point overall and 1.1 point on urgence, but the generalisation gap widens from 4.7 to 6.7 points. This checkpoint is retained and exported; further epochs are not obviously worthwhile without real data.
